claims.claim: promptarena skill commands install, list and remove shared skills from Git repositories or local paths
The PromptKit CLI binary is named promptarena
Command: promptarena skill install @anthropic/pdf-processing
The @org/name reference form is accepted by skill install
Example repository @anthropic/pdf-processing exists
Command: promptarena skill install @anthropic/pdf-processing@v1.0.0 installs a specific Git tag or ref
Command: promptarena skill install ./path/to/my-skill installs from a local directory
For @org/name references the CLI clones https://github.com/org/name
If a version is given, the CLI checks out that Git tag or ref
The default install location is ~/.config/promptkit/skills/org/name/
The CLI verifies the installed directory contains a valid SKILL.md file
Command: promptarena skill install @anthropic/pci-compliance --project
Flag --project installs to project-level instead of user-level
Project-level install goes to .promptkit/skills/anthropic/pci-compliance/ relative to the current directory
Project-level skills take priority over user-level skills during resolution
Flag --into installs a skill directly into a given directory
Command: promptarena skill install @anthropic/pci-compliance --into ./skills/billing
--into installs to ./skills/billing/pci-compliance/ (the skill name is appended to the --into directory)
--into is mutually exclusive with --project
Command: promptarena skill list shows installed skills grouped by location
Expected output has a 'Project:' group and a 'User:' group, each line formatted as '<name>  (<path>)'
Command: promptarena skill remove @anthropic/pdf-processing
skill remove deletes the skill directory from its installed location
A pack's skills array is where installed skills are referenced
Pack field skills is an array of objects
Skill entry field path accepts @org/name references such as @anthropic/pci-compliance
Skill entry field preload is a boolean that is accepted with a local path entry
Example references @anthropic/refund-processing exist as installable skills
Example local skill path skills/local-skill is resolved relative to the pack file
The runtime resolves @org/name references from installed skill directories automatically
Resolution step 1: inline skill defined directly in the pack JSON is matched first
Resolution step 2: a relative path is resolved from the pack file location
Resolution step 3: project-level directory .promptkit/skills/org/name/
Resolution step 4: user-level directory ~/.config/promptkit/skills/org/name/
The first match wins in resolution order
Skills Reference at https://promptkit.altairalabs.ai/reference/skills covers SKILL.md format, pack configuration, and SDK API
Link /arena/reference/cli-commands#promptarena-skill resolves to a skill command section in cli-commands
The cli-commands skill section is the complete skill command reference
skill remove deletes one copy per call and reports a copy that remains installed
Skill entry field path accepts @org/name references to installed skills
An @org/name reference resolves to .promptkit/skills beside the config, then the working directory's .promptkit/skills, then the user directory; packc keeps the reference in the pack
